[[File:GamorreanClown-BFR.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clown in [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Carnival]]]]
{{Quote|Yahoo! Keep running, you armored clowns!|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 4">[[Star Wars (1977) 4|''Star Wars'' (1977) 4]]</ref>}}
'''Clowns''' were beings who dressed funny and/or acted ridiculous. They are often used for performances and comedies, and are similar in roles to [[Jester (occupation)/Legends|jesters]]. They are generally identified by possessing outlandish clothing and wearing makeup, generally given colors of white with some colored lips. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] often used the term as an insult. [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] clowns often performed in [[Circus/Legends|circuses]].
